description: TRIGGERS a sync run for the given sync id — this KICKS OFF a live data sync that writes records into the connected destination SaaS tool. Set force_full_sync=true to re-sync all rows instead of just changes. Census: POST /syncs/{id}/trigger.

force_full_sync.description: Re-sync ALL rows instead of just changes since the last run.

id.description: The resource id (a numeric id, passed as a string).

name: census_trigger_sync
title: Trigger sync
